note: Free public Base JSON-RPC endpoints, each verified with eth_chainId returning 0x2105, a JSON-RPC batch, eth_feeHistory with reward percentiles, a Multicall3 eth_call, a 10,000-block eth_getLogs window, and logs from the USDC deployment. Endpoints that refused eth_getLogs or capped it below that width, needed a key, or were unreachable were left out, including the official mainnet.base.org, which refuses eth_getLogs to the public. PublicNode refuses every receipt and any logs outside its recent history with HTTP 403, so receipts and older windows come from the others. Pocket Network's gateway sometimes routes to a node far behind the tip, which refuses a window that ends past its head, so the request moves on to another endpoint. The websocket rows carry the newHeads subscription that wakes a sync pass when blocks land, and each was verified by subscribing and receiving a push. The history API row is the Etherscan v2 multichain service, which only serves Base under chainid 8453 on paid plans. A free key is refused for this chain, and history falls back to logs and balances.

endpoints.note: PublicNode, no key, recent history only
